title: The Return of Raju
desc: A widow decides to seek the help of her husband's spirit when she sees the marital life of her son shattering in front of her.

title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
desc: In a strange faraway town, small-time crooks Bade and Chote stir up double trouble and leave their policemen look-alikes flapping around like headless chickens.

title: Haan Maine Bhi Pyaar Kiya
desc: Pooja divorces her husband for being unfaithful and gets a job as secretary to a film star. The two fall in love, before her ex-husband returns and she finds herself confused between the two men.

title: Pralay the Destroyer
desc: Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.

title: Ajay
desc: Manorama falls in love with Ajay, even though they come from different social backgrounds. They want to get married, but Manorama's uncles try their best to separate the happy couple.
